question: Guru Makar Dhwaja Darogha, was conferred the Padma Shri award for his contribution to which form of dance in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chhau.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Darogha was awarded Padma Shri in 2011 for his outstanding contribution to the promotion of the Seraikela form of Chhau dance.
 
• Makar Dhwaja Darogha was an Indian classical dancer and guru, known for his expertise in the classical dance form of Chhau.
 
• Chhau dance, also spelt Chhou dance, is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial and folk traditions.
 
• It is found in three styles named after the location where they are performed, i.e. the Purulia Chhau of West Bengal, the Seraikella Chhau of Jharkhand, and the Mayurbhanj Chhau of Odisha. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some other important classical dance forms of India.
 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Tamil Nadu (Southern India).
 
• Manipuri Dance, Manipur (North-eastern India).
 
• Kathak (Northern India).
 
• Odissi Dance, Orissa (Eastern India).
 
• Kathakali. 
 
• Mohiniattam. 
 
• Kuchipudi (Southern India).
 
• Sattriya Dance
